verdict.rationale: Stripe's ACS/ACP/OCA model is explicitly partnership-gated rather than open/keyless: sellers must onboard through ACS (private preview, waitlisted, limited geographies) and agents must establish an Order Creation Agreement — "Only a seller can initiate an OCA request... After both parties confirm the OCA, it authorizes data access," while ChatGPT-style listing requires an application ("you'll need to apply"). No evidence shows an agent can search products across arbitrary merchants without such a bilateral agreement or seller-approved connection; Stripe Directory and the MCP server address provider discovery/Stripe API tooling, not cross-merchant product search.
